expectations.buyer: Industrial asset owners, automation engineering, maintenance, procurement, system integrators, and OEM lifecycle teams
expectations.pain: A PLC, HMI, drive, or controls component reaches restricted support or end of life without a source-linked migration path, installed-base context, or replacement window
expectations.strongestIncumbent: OEM lifecycle notices and product portals, CMMS/EAM and asset registers, distributors, integrators, MRO procurement, and obsolescence-management standards
expectations.biggestRisk: OEM portals own lifecycle truth, asset owners lack clean installed-base data, substitutions require engineering validation, and integrators can bundle the work
